opportunities.title: Butterfield Awards in medicine and health

deadlines.raw: 1 December, for a decision in March of the following year

next_open_date.raw: 1 December, for a decision in March of the following year

amount.raw: Butterfield Awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK. They are intended to be broad in application and can also support the study of scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare. The grants may be used for travel expenses, or to contribute to other costs including conference and publication costs. The grants may be awarded for one year, two years, or three years, up to a maximum of £10,000 per year, to a total limit of £30,000.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should normally be able to show an existing research record, but consideration will also be given to practitioners, managers, carers or others in health-related fields who intend to establish working links between organisations or produce a publishable comparative study. Preference will be given to those who have not previously been involved in UK-Japan collaboration, and applications from those in the early stages of their career are particularly welcomed.
opportunities.summary: The Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation takes applications once a year for Butterfield Awards of up to £10,000 in the field of medicine and health. The awards support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK.
